reviewed_proposal.alternative_not_selected: B — stronger weight and thin outline
reviewed_proposal.comparison_boundary: The standalone review uses system typography. Actual graphs must retain their game font, transparent background, shadows and curve-following placement. Its stacked fraction is a typography sample, not proof that the curved SVG renderer implements stacked fractions.

decision_interpretation_not_a_quote: Graph option A is approved. Do not ask Lexer to choose A versus B again.
Apply the approved treatment to formulas and matching minimum/maximum labels; preserve the existing requirements for readable powers and fractions.
Approval of a proposal does not establish implementation, delivery or installed-game acceptance. Keep issue 299 actionable until that work is ready.
Both menu-bar proposals for issue 99 were rejected. Graph A approval does not approve menu layout A.
Do not resume the excluded codex/worklog consolidation issue 86. This record only preserves the new design feedback.

issue_before_edit.title: Improve formula readability without losing the game style
issue_before_edit.body:
Make graph formulas, fractions and powers easier to read while keeping the game font, shadow, transparent background and curve-following placement. Minimum/maximum labels must match.

**Status: Redesign deferred.** The unwanted boxed overlay has been removed and Blank now has editable graph examples. New alternatives still need preparing before a design review.
